close_reason: Documented in TrustAnchor rustdoc: RFC 5280 §6.1.1(c) intentionally excludes anchor validity from path validation. Expired root CAs in trust stores are by design.
description: TrustAnchor does not carry a validity period, and validate_path never checks notBefore/notAfter for the anchor. RFC 5280 §6.1.1(c) says the trust anchor's self-signed certificate (if present) is not validated. However, callers using TrustAnchor::from_cert() may expect that an expired root cert extracted from a trust store is still usable as a trust anchor (which is fine per RFC), but callers who assume the validator rejects expired anchors will be surprised. This is not a correctness bug per RFC but creates a security surprise: a TrustAnchor built from an expired root cert will still anchor a path. Needs explicit documentation.
title: trust anchor validity period not checked
